_comment: Single source of truth for the graphics resources. tools/build-asset.sh reads
the tier settings to know how to emit each asset; scripts/embed-gfx.py reads the
ids/labels/lowmem flags to know how to embed the results. Add an asset here
PICT files are named <name>_<tier>.pict for single-frame assets and
<name>_<tier>_f<N>.pict when frames > 1 -- the convention already on disk.
Tiers: 'color' -> indexed PICT for Colour QuickDraw Macs; 'se' -> 1-bit BitMap
PICT that ORIGINAL QuickDraw (Mac SE, Plus, Classic) can actually draw; 'sdl'
-> BMP sprite atlas for the modern SDL client. Resource ids must match the
lowmem: keep this resource in bombertalk_gfx_lowmem.r (the 68k MacTCP / Mac SE
build). Colour-only resources set it false to stay out of that resource fork.
